verdict.rationale: Asana can be driven headlessly through a documented RESTful JSON API with token-based authorization. It also offers official JavaScript and Python client libraries, webhooks for event-driven automation, a published OpenAPI spec, and a developer sandbox for testing automation safely. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific documentation (e.g., service-account or CI pipeline guidance), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
